_meta.description: An event a campaign holds (an information evening, a webinar, an open day) and the registrations for it. The PqEvenement board draws one event: when and where, how many places, the registrations with their status, where they came from and the form they used. Additive: two new schemas, nothing existing changes.

campaignEvent.title: Campaign event
campaignEvent.summary: One event a campaign holds, with its place, its capacity and its sign-up form.
campaignEvent.description: An event people register for: an information evening, a webinar, an open day. It belongs to a campaign, so its registrations count in the campaign's report. capacity is the number of places; a registration past it goes on the waiting list. The sign-up form is a portaliq form; formTitle, pageUrl and signupClosesAt say where it is and until when it takes sign-ups.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: The event's reference, as it appears on confirmations.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description: The campaign this event belongs to.

venue.title: Venue
venue.description: Where the event is, as the invitation names it.

capacity.title: Places
capacity.description: How many people can come. A registration past it goes on the waiting list.

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.description: The colleagues who host the event (Nextcloud user ids).

reminderAt.title: Reminder
reminderAt.description: When the reminder mail goes to everyone registered.

formTitle.title: Form
formTitle.description: The name of the portaliq sign-up form.

pageUrl.title: On page
pageUrl.description: The page the sign-up form is on.

signupClosesAt.title: Closes
signupClosesAt.description: Until when the form takes sign-ups.

eventRegistration.title: Registration
eventRegistration.summary: One person or household registered for an event.
eventRegistration.description: A sign-up for an event, from the portaliq form, a newsletter reply or a colleague. status says whether the person has a place, waits for one or cancelled; waitlistPosition orders the waiting list. contact links the person once known in pipelinq.

event.title: Campaign event
event.description: The event this registration is for.

street.title: Street
street.description: The street of the address, for filtering a neighbourhood.

partySize.title: People
partySize.description: How many people come on this registration.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the person has a place.

waitlistPosition.title: Waiting list position
waitlistPosition.description: The place on the waiting list, 1 first.

question.title: Question
question.description: A question the person asked for the event.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: The person in pipelinq, once linked.

newContact.title: New in pipelinq
newContact.description: The registration had no existing record and became a new contact.
